process.instruction: Resolve the canonical Syllabus structure, learning progression, modules, learning activities, and learning evidence.
Distribute the Syllabus into the requested number of teaching weeks while preserving conceptual progression, prerequisite relationships, and course coherence.
Validate complete Syllabus coverage, temporal coherence, and traceability from every week to its source Syllabus module or modules.
Materialize the weekly teaching Agenda without modifying the source Syllabus.
